sources.title: Qatar University Undergraduate Catalog 2026-2027
used_for: Program degree requirements (total credit hours, category breakdowns) for Computer Science and Computer Engineering majors
Full course descriptions, credit hours, and prerequisite/corequisite chains for all CMPS, CMPE, ELEC, MATH, GENG, CHEM, PHYS courses referenced by both roadmaps
Official multi-year Study Plan tables for both programs
Major elective course lists and concentration requirements (Cybersecurity, Data Science)
sources.extraction_method: Converted to text with pypdf (1214 pages) and searched/read directly; raw text cached at data/raw/catalog_fulltext.txt

sources.title: Qatar University 150% Graduation Rate Per Cohort (Qatar Open Data Portal)
sources.used_for: University-wide (not program-specific) 150%-of-standard-duration graduation rates for Fall 2012-2016 cohorts (57.15%-73.58% overall). Used only as a calibration reference for assumed program-level graduation-timeline splits, since no CS/CE-specific on-time graduation rate is published. Cached at data/raw/enrollment_real_data.json.

data_still_not_available: Program-specific (CS/CE) on-time (<=8 term) graduation rate -- only university-wide 150% cohort rates are published
Number of sections offered per course per term
Published course pass/fail or grade distribution statistics per course

note: Real enrollment and degrees-awarded figures (2017/18-2021/22) for both CS and CE were found on qu.edu.qa and are recorded in data/raw/enrollment_real_data.json; derived CAGR values (CS 27.2%/yr, CE 13.7%/yr) seed the Enrollment Forecasting page defaults. Per-course pass rates, section capacities, and sections-offered counts remain unpublished and are documented as assumptions in data/assumptions.json -- these can be replaced by faculty via the Data Override panel.
